tasks.title: Implement qualified scheduler persistence, trusted catalog and coherent active revisions
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Extend the one Management PostgreSQL authority through explicit versioned migration/readiness and optional scheduler backend companion. Persist trusted immutable definition/configured-trigger/task revisions, logical identities, desired/active references and bounded execution capsules with positive configured quota; normal startup does no DDL and unselected consumers stay compatible. Apply trusted catalog conflicts and guarded task preview/promotion using exact original Operations/Audit conventions and RM08 publication/release/assignment/owner-adoption. Prior active revision remains until coherent promotion/disable; shared changes visibly revalidate every affected task against current preconditions without overwriting edits. Definitions are passive; unsupported mapper/editor/identity/contract blocks activation. Preserve exact names/IDs and configuration ownership; no arbitrary executable handler creation. Owns RM10-AC01, RM10-AC02, RM10-AC03, RM10-AC11, RM10-AC12, RM10-AC13, RM10-AC27, RM10-AC28, RM10-AC29, RM10-AC31, RM10-AC35, RM10-AC40.
tasks.validation: Prove explicit migration from retained schema, startup read-only readiness, trusted version conflicts and exact target authorization. Run native guarded active-revision/shared-edit/adoption/ETag races and original operation replay/Audit rollback cases. Reserve shared schema edits to this owner; document options, transaction/lock order, adoption boundaries and migration. Include meaningful focused native/unit or browser checks for this implementation, affected documentation, and proportionate independent review; preserve failures and actual joined cleanup. Do not turn authored tests or reused evidence from different source bytes into a pass. Verify this owner consumes only the declared medium prerequisites (WORK-151, WORK-152, WORK-153, WORK-154) and keeps the original parent accounting pool; broad provenance containers are not early completion prerequisites.
